preferences.title: Cookies & preferences
preferences.description: Browser storage supports navigation and remembers your privacy choice. Allow saves your appearance for future visits; Skip leaves optional storage off. You can change your choice at any time.

sections.title: About this notice
sections.text: This notice explains how information is handled when you visit Artan Davoodi's music and visual portfolio, and the choices available to you.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.text: Cookies and browser storage are technologies that can retain information on a device. This website uses local storage to retain your allow or decline choice for up to 180 days and session storage for gallery navigation. If you allow optional preferences, local storage also remembers your theme and whether the introduction has been shown. You can withdraw permission through Cookies & preferences. Without permission, the theme can still be changed on the current page but is not saved between visits. External services have their own cookie notices and choices.

sections.title: Gallery navigation
sections.text: When you open a photograph, session storage temporarily remembers your gallery page, filters, scroll position and selected image so that returning restores your place. It is used for gallery navigation, not sent to the artist, and removed when restored or when the browser session ends.

sections.title: Visiting this website
sections.text: The hosting service processes connection information, including IP addresses, to deliver and protect the website. Following a streaming, social or other external link opens a separate service with its own privacy practices.

sections.title: Email enquiries
sections.text: When you send an enquiry, your email address and message are used to respond to you. Email providers also process the message to deliver it. Please include only information relevant to your enquiry. To ask about a message you have sent or request its deletion, contact contact@artandavoodi.com.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.text: Artan Davoodi (legal name: Saeed Davoodi), operating from Croatia, is responsible for the personal information described in this notice. You can withdraw optional storage permission at any time and clear this site's browser data. Contact contact@artandavoodi.com to ask about access, correction, deletion or other applicable data-protection rights. You may also contact Croatia's data-protection authority, AZOP.

sections.title: Artan Store
sections.text: Artan Store has a separate privacy notice covering its account services and the information handled when you use the store. Please read that notice when visiting store.artandavoodi.com.
